verses.69:7: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالࣲ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومࣰ اۖ فَتَرَى ٱلۡقَوۡمَ فِيهَا صَرۡعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةࣲ‏

meaning: The root حسم (Hsm) primarily means "to cut off entirely" or "to stop." It's used for cutting and cauterizing a vein to stop bleeding, or stopping a disease with a remedy.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
